meta.notes: Seeded from devicePEQ by scripts/import/seed.ts. Values are what devicePEQ's handler encodes, not verified device limits. devicePEQ also lists band-stop and constant-Q peaking filters. Band-stop is the notch (NO); constant-Q peaking has no code in the format. Reported quirk, not corrected (D39): devicePEQ reports that filters come out wider than the Q sent as gain grows (Q / 10^(|gain|/40)), and that shelf frequencies move with gain.
